source_basis: Canvas distinguishes an assignment due date from the separate availability window.
subject: CZ4013 essay assignment
body: The CZ4013 essay assignment is due on 10 October 2026 at 11:59 PM SGT. The submission page remains available until 12 October 2026 at 11:59 PM SGT.

source_basis: An availability date controls access and is not necessarily the assessed due date.
subject: CZ4013 submission page availability
body: The CZ4013 assignment is available until 12 October 2026 at 11:59 PM SGT.

source_basis: Google Classroom treats scheduled publication separately from an optional assignment due date.
subject: AB1201 classwork publication
body: The AB1201 assignment is scheduled to post on 5 October 2026 at 3:00 PM SGT. The due date will be announced separately.

source_basis: Only classwork with due dates appears in the Classroom and Google calendars.
subject: AB1201 reflection assignment
body: The AB1201 reflection assignment is due on 9 October 2026 at 5:00 PM SGT.

source_basis: Canvas notes that due dates normally include a time, so a missing time is unsafe to infer.
